description: Distinguish three causal hypotheses for a real1ms discrepancy between numerical engines: sampled event timestamp changes, waveform/filter history or publication defect, or initial effective-state mismatch. Derive the discriminator using recorded boundaries and exact filter equations, not a tolerance relaxation.

Implement and execute paired instrumented1ms trajectories with unchanged equations, then replay actual recorded membrane inputs in small fixtures. Verify that instrumentation leaves all exported state exactly unchanged and reconstruct filter outputs from actual event marks.

Review supplied code and measured whole-organism fidelity/performance before scientific stage3 use. User authorizes automatic transition only when engine evidence supports it. Assess scope of short tests, what remains unresolved and whether a long campaign is interpretable; do not approve based on votes or synthetic-only speed.
